b1-35-01.title: Communicative Challenge: If I Could Choose
b1-35-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks where you would study if you could choose any place. You would choose to spend a year in Madrid, where his grandmother lives.
b1-35-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what you would choose if you had the option.
cues: Say that you imagine having the option
b1-35-01.target: Si tuviera la opción, estudiaría un año en Madrid.
b1-35-01.english: If I had the option, I would study for a year in Madrid.
b1-35-01.canDo: I can express hypothetical choices and preferences.

b1-35-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Week of Rain
b1-35-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what would happen if it rained all week in Budapest. You would not go out, and you would work at home.
b1-35-02.prompt: Tell Meg what would happen if it rained all week.
cues: Say what you would not do
Say what you would do instead
b1-35-02.target: Si lloviera toda la semana, no saldríamos y yo trabajaría en casa.
b1-35-02.english: If it rained all week, we would not go out and I would work at home.

b1-35-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Missed Concert
b1-35-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you did not go to the concert last Friday. You had an exam the next morning. Without the exam, you would have gone.
b1-35-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what would have happened without the exam.
cues: Say what you would have done
b1-35-03.target: Si no hubiera tenido un examen, habría ido al concierto.
b1-35-03.english: If I had not had an exam, I would have gone to the concert.
b1-35-03.canDo: I can refer to unreal past situations.

b1-35-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Summer Plans
b1-35-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you would do with two free weeks in the summer. You could visit your grandmother in Madrid. If that were not possible, you would stay in Budapest.
cues: Say what you could do with two weeks
Say what you would do if that were not possible
b1-35-04.target: Si tuviera dos semanas libres, podría visitar a mi abuela en Madrid. Si no fuera posible, me quedaría en Budapest.
b1-35-04.english: If I had two free weeks, I could visit my grandmother in Madrid. If it were not possible, I would stay in Budapest.

b1-35-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Green Eyes
b1-35-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read the legend of the green eyes for your class in Budapest, and Carlos asks what happens. Íñigo warned Fernando that an evil spirit lived in the spring of Los Álamos, but Fernando kept going back there.
b1-35-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Íñigo said and what would have happened if Fernando had listened.
cues: Say what Íñigo said about the spring
Say what Fernando would not have done if he had listened
b1-35-05.target: Íñigo le dijo a Fernando que en la fuente vivía un espíritu del mal. Si Fernando hubiera hecho caso, no habría vuelto a la fuente.
b1-35-05.english: Íñigo told Fernando that an evil spirit lived in the spring. If Fernando had listened, he would not have gone back to the spring.
b1-35-05.canDo: I can reflect on choices and alternatives.

b1-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: More Time for Spanish
b1-35-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if you wish you had studied more Spanish before moving to Budapest. You did not have much time then, and you still do not have much time now.
b1-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you would have done and what you would do with more time.
cues: Say what you would have done with more time before
Say what you would do now with more time
b1-35-consolidation.target: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría estudiado español antes. Si tuviera más tiempo ahora, estudiaría todos los días.
b1-35-consolidation.english: If I had had more time, I would have studied Spanish earlier. If I had more time now, I would study every day.
b1-35-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate present/future hypothetical structures.
